question: Which of the following square root expressions is in simplest radical form?
solution: \(\sqrt{8}=2\sqrt{2}\) and \(\sqrt{12}=2\sqrt{3}\) have perfect-square factors, and the radicand of \(\sqrt{1/2}\) contains a denominator. Only \(\sqrt{7}\) is in simplest radical form.
